stories.title: No OpenAI IPO Until the AI Stops Going Rogue, CEO Sam Altman Says
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's CEO says the company won't sell shares to the public (go public) until they can prove their AI is safe and won't act unexpectedly in harmful ways.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who own OpenAI stock — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Sam Altman says OpenAI won’t go public until its models are safe
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's leader is saying they won't become a public company until they're confident their AI systems are dependable and safe, with no specific date announced.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: America.gov gets really weird when you ask it about Minecraft, but it’s not a glitch
stories.simple_summary: America.gov (the official US government website) sometimes gives strange answers about video games, but this is intentional, not a mistake.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect ordinary people or small businesses — it's just a curiosity about government websites.

stories.title: Trump orders US government to call AI ‘Super Intelligence’
stories.simple_summary: President Trump ordered all US government websites and documents to stop using the word "artificial intelligence" and call it "Super Intelligence" instead.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly a name change that won't affect how AI actually works or how you use it.

stories.title: The internet is convinced Elon Musk’s xAI trolled OpenAI’s ‘Dots’ launch
stories.simple_summary: Elon Musk's AI company bought the web address "dot.com" before OpenAI launched a new tool called Dots, as a playful joke or competitive move.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a competition between tech companies — nothing that affects you.

stories.title: Elon Musk’s AI-powered Grokipedia is updating again
stories.simple_summary: Elon Musk's Grokipedia (an AI-powered encyclopedia like Wikipedia) is updating its articles again after pausing updates for several months.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people following Elon Musk's projects — it doesn't affect ordinary people or small businesses.

stories.title: Trump tries to rename AI 'super intelligence' as polls show him sinking on key issue
stories.simple_summary: President Trump is trying to change the name of artificial intelligence to "super intelligence."
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly a naming change — it won't affect how AI actually works or how you use it.

stories.title: OpenAI’s latest features take direct aim at the app store model
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is building features that let people use and discover different AI tools directly inside ChatGPT, rather than having to go to separate app stores.
stories.why_it_matters: This could make it easier for you to find and use AI tools in one place, similar to how a grocery store puts everything you need in one building instead of visiting ten shops.

stories.title: Pope Leo Contradicts Trump, Says Artificial Intelligence Safety Concerns Are Not 'Fake News'
stories.simple_summary: Pope Leo contradicted President Trump's comments, saying that safety concerns about AI are real and important, not false claims.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a statement from religious leadership — it doesn't directly change how AI works or affects your daily life.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly in talks to raise $30B round at $1.4T valuation
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is trying to raise $30 billion dollars in new funding from investors and is valued at $1.4 trillion.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and business watchers — it doesn't affect you unless you use ChatGPT.

stories.title: Here’s why OpenAI is absent from Nvidia’s industry-wide effort to end rogue AI agents
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI isn't publicly supporting a new industry effort from Nvidia to prevent AI systems from going rogue, but they're working with Nvidia on it privately.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech industry professionals — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI takes on Microsoft with the launch of what feels a whole lot like ChatGPT’s own office suite
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is launching office tools (like spreadsheets and documents) to compete directly with Microsoft's Office software.
stories.why_it_matters: This might give you another option if you need simple office tools, similar to how competition at a car dealership gives you more choices.
